description: Shared golden vector for the THREE stableStringify copies (platform/shared/manifest.ts, platform/edge/functions/_shared/manifest.ts, deploy/scripts/verify-publish-audit-chain.js). Each tree has a test hashing this fixture and asserting expectedCanonical/expectedSha256, so a change to any one copy fails CI in that tree until all three (and this golden) are updated together. The input deliberately includes keys whose localeCompare order differs from code-unit order (Zebra/apple, éclair/zoo, _meta) to pin the current collation behavior; the planned algorithm change (MP-D-05) must update this fixture in lockstep across all trees.

input.Zebra: uppercase-key sorts after lowercase under localeCompare
input.éclair: non-ASCII key sorts before zoo under localeCompare
